title: A torsion-free counterexample to the Kadison–Kaplansky projection conjecture

abstractEnglish: We construct a finitely generated torsion-free discrete group whose reduced group C∗-algebra contains a projection other than zero and the identity. This disproves the Kadison–Kaplansky projection conjecture.
titleEn: A torsion-free counterexample to the Kadison–Kaplansky projection conjecture

details.overview: 稿件研究离散群约化C∗代数中的投影。作者声称构造一个有限生成无挠离散群，其约化群C∗代数含有非零非恒等的投影，从而反驳Kadison–Kaplansky投影猜想。研究意义在于否定群C∗代数中关于投影的经典猜想，但结果尚未经独立审查。
keyPoints: 作者构造有限生成无挠离散群。
其约化群C∗代数含非零非恒等投影。
